title: Ceramics Open Studio
source_quote: Open Studio pass holders can sign up for 3 sessions per week for a total of 12 per pass. 12 Packs of Open studio expire after 45 days.
evidence_sentence: Open studio participants can use the gas reduction kiln by purchasing a 12-pack pass for $180 and paying separate firing fees tracked through Kiln Fire.
evidence_quote: Firing fees are tracked, ticketed, and paid separately through Kiln Fire. 1 Gas Reduction Kiln
summary: Purchase a 12-pack open studio pass ($180) and book time slots. Pay for kiln firings separately through the Kiln Fire system. Pass expires after 45 days.
cost_text: $180 for 12 open studio sessions; kiln firing fees paid separately
how_to_join: Log in or sign up as a Kiln Fire user, purchase the 12 Pack of Open Studio in the Supplies store, then book reservation times.
pay_text: $180 for 12-pack pass; firing fees paid separately through Kiln Fire
